KW-02 routes implemented in BFF: create/list/detail, owner_ref server assignment, attachment/memory validation, and degraded surface semantics. Verified with pytest: test_kw02_research_notes_contract.py, test_kw01_institutional_memory_contract.py, test_pkt016_knowledge_workbench_contract.py.

Review found a KW-02 contract bug: GET /api/v1/knowledge/notes derives research_note_list surface health from bool(filtered_notes), so a legitimate empty result set is reported as unavailable. Reproduced on a service-backed store by creating one note and querying with tags=does-not-match; response is 200 with notes=[] but meta.surfaces.research_note_list=unavailable. Please make surface health reflect dataset availability rather than post-filter row count, then rerun test_kw02_research_notes_contract.py, test_kw01_institutional_memory_contract.py, and test_pkt016_knowledge_workbench_contract.py with an added empty-filter regression.

Fixed KW-02 list surface health to reflect research_notes dataset availability before filters, added the empty-filter regression, and re-ran pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/test_kw02_research_notes_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_kw01_institutional_memory_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_pkt016_knowledge_workbench_contract.py (4 passed, 4 passed, 1 passed).

Review requested changes: KW-02 list surface health still misreports an empty but available research_notes store as unavailable. See docs/reviews/2026-04-21-exec-bff-kw02-001-codex-rereview.md and fix list availability from dataset source rather than bool(notes), then add an empty-store regression and re-handoff for review.

Fixed KW-02 list availability to derive from research_notes dataset source instead of bool(notes), added empty service-store regression coverage, and reran pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/test_kw02_research_notes_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_kw01_institutional_memory_contract.py services/control-plane/bff/test_pkt016_knowledge_workbench_contract.py (5 passed, 5 passed).
